comment: Parameters 19 and 20 and inputs 19 and 20 are the chip's two sixteen-bit pairing flags; the maker commented them out of the widget, so none of the four can be reached on the panel. Each switch and its jack combine as an exclusive or, so the jack going high inverts whatever the switch has chosen.
